PR: feat: add xpkg batch command [closed]
### Description of your changes

This PR ports the `xpkg batch` functionality from the `up` tool to the Crossplane CLI as a new command `crossplane xpkg batch`. This functionality is used by family providers to batch build their smaller providers in parallel batches, e.g. https://github.com/crossplane-contrib/provider-upjet-aws/blob/main/cluster/images/provider-aws/Makefile#L65-L84. The port to the crossplane CLI makes uses of the existing `xpkg push` functionality, with a bit of refactoring, to push the images to

the remote.

With the `xpkg batch` functionality upstream, we'll be able to completely remove usage of the `up` tool from the Crossplane ecosystem, further supporting our community goals of vendor neutrality.

This implementation is largely ported from `up` with minor changes for readability and maintainability, as well as removing Upbound specific functionality.
